entries.name: Booking.com
entries.reviewed_sections: Owner decision; historical terms findings retained in the base registry.
entries.justification: Allowed for read/prepare-only automation by owner decision in docs/handoff/lift-site-exclusions.md, not site-granted authorization. No payment, submission, accounts, consent or CAPTCHA bypass; in-session screenshots only.

adapters.success_evidence: Selected room AND rate, exact dates and adults, full-stay total visible; stop at the untouched guest-details boundary. Provisional URL pattern requires live validation; never infer selection from a URL alone.
adapters.blocked_evidence: No availability, dates not on sale, sold out, wrong city/dates/party, required login, captcha or consent. Search results and unselected hotel pages are not ready.
